'''Manliss Enterprise''' was a criminal organization responsible for the production of two-thirds of all the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] in the [[Portmoak sector/Legends|Portmoak sector]]. Originally run by [[Dunstain Manliss]], the organization was taken over by his son, [[Artur Manliss]], after he killed his father. Manliss Enterprise was part of [[Mandroxan]].
